markdown.markdown: Interactive visualization of how research concepts connect across papers. Click on any concept to see related papers and connections. ```{mermaid} flowchart TB subgraph Agents["AI Agents"] A1[Tool Use] A2[Planning] A3[World Models] A4[Multi-Agent] A5[Safety & Governance] end subgraph Reasoning["LLM Reasoning"] R1[Chain-of-Thought] R2[Early Exit] R3[Verification] R4[Token Budget] end subgraph Retrieval["RAG & Retrieval"] T1[Dense Retrieval] T2[Knowledge Graphs] T3[Hybrid Search] T4[Intent-Aligned] end subgraph Multimodal["Multi-Modal"] M1[Vision-Language] M2[Document Understanding] M3[Multimodal Safety] M4[Continual Learning] end %% Cross-domain connections A1 --> R1 A2 --> R2 A3 --> M1 A4 --> M1 A5 --> T4 R1 --> T1 R3 --> T2 M1 --> T1 M2 --> T2 M3 --> A5 ``` ## Concept Definitions ### AI Agents Autonomous systems that perceive their environment, reason about actions, and execute tools to achieve goals. **Key Concepts:** - **Tool Use**: Agents can call APIs, execute code, and interact with external systems - **Planning**: Breaking complex goals into sequential steps with verification - **World Models**: Internal simulations for predictive planning without real-world interaction - **Multi-Agent Systems**: Multiple specialized agents collaborating on complex tasks - **Safety & Governance**: Ensuring agents act within policy boundaries **Recent Papers:** - [WM-R1: Training GUI Agents with World Models](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27508-WM-R1-Training-GUI-Agents-to-Reason-and-leverage-W.html) - [If Agents Were Angels: Governance at Tool Boundaries](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27646-If-Agents-Were-Angels-No-Governance-Would-Be-Neces.html) - [SETU: Multilingual Communication Coaching Agent](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27524-SETU-An-Agentic-Ecosystem-for-Multilingual-Persona.html) ### LLM Reasoning Methods for improving how language models think through complex problems step-by-step. **Key Concepts:** - **Chain-of-Thought**: Sequential reasoning through intermediate steps - **Early Exit**: Stopping reasoning when answers stabilize (saves 30-50% tokens) - **Verification**: Checking intermediate steps for correctness - **Token Budget**: Understanding when reasoning overhead helps vs hurts **Recent Papers:** - [SABER: Stability-Aware Early Exit](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27963-SABER-Stability-Aware-Early-Exit-for-LLM-Reasoning.html) - [Thinking Costs Tokens: Budget Thresholds](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27506-Thinking-Costs-Tokens-When-More-Structure-is-Worth.html) - [The Illusion of What If: Counterfactual Reasoning](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27953-The-Illusion-of-textitWhat-If-Evaluating-the-Break.html) ### RAG & Retrieval Techniques for grounding LLM outputs in retrieved external knowledge. **Key Concepts:** - **retrieval" onclick="window.location.href='wiki.html'">retrieval" onclick="window.location.href='wiki.html'">Dense Retrieval**: Semantic search using learned embedding" onclick="window.location.href='wiki.html'">embedding" onclick="window.location.href='wiki.html'">embeddings - **Knowledge Graphs**: Structured representations for explicit reasoning - **Hybrid Search**: Combining dense and sparse retrieval methods - **Intent-Aligned Retrieval**: Matching retrieval to user intent for safety **Recent Papers:** - [Retrieving Relations, Detecting Fallacies](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27471-Retrieving-Relations-Detecting-Fallacies-A-RAG-App.html) - [CareGraph: Hybrid AI for Health Intelligence](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27484-CareGraph-An-Auditable-Hybrid-AI-Framework-for-Evi.html) - [Cross-Session Decomposition Attacks](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27945-Cross-Session-Decomposition-Attacks-Scaling-Risk-a.html) ### Multi-Modal Models Systems that process and reason across multiple data types (text, images, audio, video). **Key Concepts:** - **Vision-Language Models**: Processing images and text together - **Document Understanding**: Reading and reasoning about structured documents - **Multimodal Safety**: Content moderation across modalities - **Continual Learning**: Acquiring new capabilities without forgetting old ones **Recent Papers:** - [See, Hypothesize, Validate: Multimodal PDE Discovery](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27869-See-Hypothesize-Validate-Multimodal-Agentic-Framew.html) - [WeAgent-MMSearch: Text-Vision Search Agents](papers/2026-08-31/2608.28062-WeAgent-MMSearch-Native-Text-Vision-Interaction-fo.html) - [Nemotron 3.5: Multimodal Safety Moderation](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27548-Nemotron-35-Content-Safety-Moderator-A-Compact-Mul.html) ## Cross-Domain Connections Many breakthrough papers span multiple research areas: **Agents + Reasoning + World Models:** - [WM-R1](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27508-WM-R1-Training-GUI-Agents-to-Reason-and-leverage-W.html) combines agent architecture, reasoning efficiency, and world models for GUI automation **Agents + Retrieval + Safety:** - [Cross-Session Decomposition Attacks](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27945-Cross-Session-Decomposition-Attacks-Scaling-Risk-a.html) reveals safety risks at the intersection of agents and retrieval **Multi-Modal + Agents + Verification:** - [See, Hypothesize, Validate](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27869-See-Hypothesize-Validate-Multimodal-Agentic-Framew.html) demonstrates multimodal agents with explicit verification for scientific discovery **Reasoning + Retrieval:** - [From Documents to Reasoning](papers/2026-08-31/2608.27919-From-Documents-to-Reasoning-A-Validated-Synthetic.html) shows retrieval-grounded reasoning for financial QA ## Research Trends ### Efficiency is King Multiple papers focus on reducing computational costs while maintaining quality: - Early exit methods save 30-50% of tokens - Token budget thresholds show when reasoning helps vs hurts - Compact models for specific tasks outperform large general models ### Safety at Scale As capabilities increase, so do attack surfaces: - Compositional safety risks from combining benign queries - Need for governance at trusted tool boundaries - Multimodal safety requires new approaches ### Hybrid Approaches Win Combining methods often outperforms pure approaches: - Hybrid neuro-symbolic AI (CareGraph) - Hybrid search (dense + sparse retrieval) - Agents with both world models and real-world interaction ## Explore Further - [Glossary](concepts/glossary.html) - Definitions of all key terms - [Papers by Concept](concepts/papers-by-concept.html) - Papers organized by concepts they address - [Learning Paths](learning-paths.html) - Structured reading guides - [Weekly Digests](digests/index.html) - Trend analysis and highlights
